title: Keep the review budget closed when series state is deleted
body:
Outcome: after .krn/runs/review-series/<key> is removed, the next reservation for that PR is refused instead of restarting at ordinal 1; the anchor survives `rm -rf .krn/runs` (a git ref in the common dir or an anchor under .krn/ outside runs/, consistent with KRN-08).
Evidence: src/flow/series.ts:204; PR #162 reserved ordinal 1 at 2026-11-02T07:42:44Z after seven consumed attempts; .krn/runs/program-audit/synthesis.md.
